name: product-page-conversion-fixer
description: Every week, finds products that get plenty of views but few add-to-carts, works out from the product's own record what is holding them back, and proposes fixes for you to approve.

howItWorks.label: Finds
howItWorks.text: Products with many views and an add-to-cart rate well below your store's usual rate

howItWorks.label: Diagnoses
howItWorks.text: Thin copy, few images, sizes out of stock, missing details, or a price far above similar products

howItWorks.label: Asks you
howItWorks.text: To approve copy and detail fixes; price is only ever a suggestion

plugins.reason: Reads views and add-to-carts per product from your GA4 ecommerce data

data.description: The product's name, matched to the item name in Google Analytics

The long description on the product page
The product's images, to count them and check alt text
The product's price, to compare with similar products
The product's category, to find similar products
Stock per variant (size, colour), to spot popular options that are sold out
Fields shoppers look for: dimensions, material, care, size guide, delivery and returns

parameters.label: Minimum product views (28 days)
parameters.description: Products seen less often than this are left out; too few views say nothing
